name: Nurul Hoque

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Nurul Hoque is a Bangladeshi poet, novelist and editor whose work appears in Bengali and English. His editorial work includes the Dhaka periodical Amader Buriganga and Odyssey International Anthology of World Poets 2020. In his essay ‘My Poetic Thoughts’, he describes poetry as an inward conversation in which human feeling and the natural world meet.

That connection is visible in the poems gathered here. ‘Life Need Compassion’ moves from suffering towards a shared call for kindness, likening compassion to sunlight. ‘You Will Come Again’ places longing on the dry bank of the Kaliganga, where heat, sand and the season of Chaitra make an awaited return feel like relief from drought.
